_provenance.purpose: Bring Japan to the same leak-proof per-fold + multi-seed + significance bar as UK/storm (capstone review item 3).
_provenance.reconstruction: text<->SPT join rebuilt locally: soil_text_layers.csv (text+coords+depth) + SPT-N re-parsed from KuniJiban XML by file_path + depth-interval. No cluster artefacts.
_provenance.baseline: depth + lat + lon (thin coordinate baseline, uniform spirit with UK/storm)
_provenance.result: content (text vs shuffled) -21.2%, 8/8 regions negative, sign/Wilcoxon p=0.0039, per-fold PCA, 5 seeds.
_provenance.relation_to_original: The original -7.3% is the MORE CONSERVATIVE estimate: full corpus (incl. no-text rows), AIST regime baseline, has_text-provenance-controlled, Sarashina + global PCA. This -21.2% is the uniform cross-domain protocol on text-bearing rows. Both honest; they measure different things. The gap (~-7% -> -21%) is the AIST-regime-baseline redundancy + has_text dilution, consistent with the provenance-confound story.
